messages:
mila: opening a compact action thread from the postmortem (INC-2026-042) - we need concrete runbook + playbook edits for worker process memory growth. focus: triage commands that actually work when logs are truncated, a clear pager escalation ladder, and a short remediation owner list.

ops-bot: On-call (2026-04-06) -> devon (SRE).

devon: i'll take runbook edits for immediate triage. plan: two sections - 'Observe' (what to check in first 5m) and 'Mitigate' (fast actions). starting draft below, feedback welcome.

arik: tagging in for playbook escalation changes. i'll map PD escalation to team rotations and include fallback if infra-leads don't ack in 10m.

callie: please also add a tiny post-restart validation checklist for service health (error-rate, tail-latency, and synthetic trace check). i'll own that piece.

devon: DRAFT triage snippet to add under /docs/runbooks/worker-memory.md:
```
OBSERVE (0-5m):
- kubectl -n svc get pod -l app=worker -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
- kubectl -n svc exec -it <pod> -- /bin/sh -c "ps aux --sort=-rss | head -n 20"
- if logs truncated, fetch archived: curl -s "https://logs.redwood.internal/archived?pod=<pod>&since=2h" | jq -r .lines | tail -n 200
- capture memory snapshot: kubectl -n svc exec <pod> -- python3 /usr/local/bin/ps_mem.py --simple > /tmp/ps_mem.txt

MITIGATE (5-20m):
- add memory limit temporarily: kubectl -n svc patch deploy worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"1Gi"}}}]}}}}'
- trigger graceful restart: kubectl -n svc rollout restart deploy/worker
- if restart doesn't reduce resident memory across pods, run gcore on suspect pid and upload: kubectl -n svc exec <pod> -- sh -c "gcore -o /tmp/core.$(date +%s) <pid> && curl -F file=@/tmp/core.* https://artifacts.redwood.internal/upload"
```

mila: good. devon, include a one-line pager blurb to paste into PD. keep it short.

devon: PagerDuty blurb (first alert):
"Worker memory alert: pod <pod> showing sustained resident growth > 200MB over 10m. Triage started. Runbook: /docs/runbooks/worker-memory.md. Oncall: <oncall>."

arik: escalation flow proposal - put in playbook as numbered steps:
1) Oncall triages (0-10m). If repeated OOMs or >2 pods affected, escalate.
2) Page infra-leads (10-20m) with PD escalation policy 'worker-critical'.
3) If cluster capacity or rollout needed, page eng-sre and execs (20-40m).
Add explicit PD escalation commands and contact links.

callie: for post-restart validation, small checklist to include in playbook:
- confirm 5m error-rate within baseline (use grafana panel id 1234)
- sample 3 traces for tail latency under 95th percentile
- check redis and DB connections don't spike
- mark incident P2 -> P3 if stable for 30m

mila: recurring pattern note: we had 3 similar incidents in 6 weeks. proposal: add prom rule that fires early:
RULE: process_resident_memory_bytes increase over 10m > 2e8 for job=worker
PROMQL:
"increase(process_resident_memory_bytes{job=\"worker\"}[10m]) > 2e8"
If this alert fires twice within 45m, auto-create incident and set severity to P2.

arik: also suggest adding a metric id annotation to the runbook so oncall can paste graphs in PD message quickly.

devon: assignments & deadlines:
- devon: write runbook triage + mitigation commands + PD blurb (due 2026-04-08)
- arik: update playbook escalation + PD escalation commands + auto-create rule mapping (due 2026-04-09)
- callie: post-restart verification checklist + grafana panel links (due 2026-04-08)
- mila: ensure the postmortem link and incident history are referenced in the runbook (due 2026-04-09)

mila: please also include a brief note on 'when to open a leak-investigation epic' - e.g., more than 2 restarts in 72h or three incidents in 30d.

devon: added that clause in draft. PR plan: docs PR titled "runbook: worker memory triage + playbook escalation mapping". i'll request review from @mila @arik @callie.

callie: i'll prepare the validation checklist as a small markdown and link to the synthetic tests.

mila: thanks all. i'll track these in the postmortem action table and follow up in next oncall retro. marking this thread as the canonical action tracker for the runbook/playbook updates. :white_check_mark:
